draw: census: all 57 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: The proposal artifact is canonically serialised as JSON with recursively sorted object keys and all whitespace removed, yielding proposal_canon.json. A third party re-derives the proposal hash as hProposal = sha256(proposal_canon.json); then derives the seed by computing seedHex = sha256(hProposal + salt), where salt = 7b40ac34e20f6f1a05eb651cdd9e230d93efdd3ec7c2415d51cd8a7ea0d8ba30, concatenated as raw hex bytes. For this CENSUS draw, all 57 witnesses from census.json are drawn in their canonical order without replacement. The draw rule is deterministic and requires only the canonical proposal artifact and the stated salt; no witness selection by the proposer, no operator choice, reproducible by any auditor who possesses proposal_canon.json and the salt.
